Exactly three bilingual criteria per item cover the two asked-for facts and understandable Dutch. Every language criterion explicitly tolerates small errors.

Compared all 98 existing speaking titles/prompts and relevant full single-picture records. Nine slugs and titles are unique. Scale, unusual placement and shared activities support three distinct themes; basic colours recur deliberately.
No closed questions occur in this batch.

Authored scenes, wording and models are original according to the source/notes. Catalogue checks found no identical titles/slugs or duplicated complete premise. No official or commercial exercise was used as a wording source; editorial review cannot prove absence across all external material.

Nine unique preserved IDs, nine picture-describe items, nine a1-spreken rubrics, nine single drawing briefs, 27 bilingual criteria, 18 content goals and 27 incomplete ordered starters. No retired type field or generated media. Final shared checker reports no failures and no warnings.
